description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (1.50 or 1.60 each), grants [Awoken Altruist], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Water, Holy)] and [Blessed Shower Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Altruist
description.text: Holy and Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Water/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Blessed Shower Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Water/Holy Blessed Shower after using two Water or Holy abilities if the triggering ability deals Water/Holy damage

description.name: Water Blessed Shower
description.text: Grants [Water Ability +30% Boost 1] and [Attach Water] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Holy Blessed Shower
description.text: Grants [Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] and [Attach Holy] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%
